verses.original: וַיְהִי֩ כְּכַלּ֨וֹת יִרְמְיָ֜הוּ לְדַבֵּ֣ר אֶל־ כָּל־ הָעָ֗ם אֶת־ כָּל־ דִּבְרֵי֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֧ר שְׁלָח֛וֹ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֖ם אֲלֵיהֶ֑ם אֵ֥ת כָּל־ הַדְּבָרִ֖ים הָאֵֽלֶּה׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·hî kə·ḵal·lō·wṯ yir·mə·yā·hū lə·ḏab·bêr ’el- kāl- hā·‘ām ’eṯ- kāl- diḇ·rê Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·hem ’ă·šer šə·lā·ḥōw Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·hem ’ă·lê·hem ’êṯ kāl- had·də·ḇā·rîm hā·’êl·leh
verses.literal: When Jeremiah had finished telling . . . all the people all the words of the LORD their God everything that . . . . . . the LORD . . . had sent him to say
verses.literalPt: E SUCEDEU que, acabando Jeremias de falar a todo o povo todas as palavras do SENHOR seu Deus, com as quais o SENHOR seu Deus lho havia enviado, para que lhes dissesse todas estas palavras,

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר עֲזַרְיָ֤ה בֶן־ הוֹשַֽׁעְיָה֙ וְיוֹחָנָ֣ן בֶּן־ קָרֵ֔חַ וְכָל־ הָאֲנָשִׁ֖ים הַזֵּדִ֑ים אֹמְרִ֣ים אֶֽל־ יִרְמְיָ֗הוּ שֶׁ֚קֶר אַתָּ֣ה מְדַבֵּ֔ר לֹ֣א שְׁלָחֲךָ֞ יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֵ֙ינוּ֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר לֹֽא־ תָבֹ֥אוּ מִצְרַ֖יִם לָג֥וּר שָֽׁם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ‘ă·zar·yāh ḇen- hō·wō·ša‘·yāh wə·yō·w·ḥā·nān ben- qā·rê·aḥ wə·ḵāl hā·’ă·nā·šîm haz·zê·ḏîm ’ō·mə·rîm ’el- yir·mə·yā·hū še·qer ’at·tāh mə·ḏab·bêr lō šə·lā·ḥă·ḵā Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū lê·mōr lō- ṯā·ḇō·’ū miṣ·ra·yim lā·ḡūr šām
verses.literal: Azariah son of Hoshaiah Johanan son of Kareah and all the arrogant men said to Jeremiah You are lying The LORD our God has not sent you to say You must not go to Egypt to reside there . . .
verses.literalPt: Então falaram Azarias, filho de Hosaías, e Joanã, filho de Careá, e todos os homens soberbos, dizendo a Jeremias: Tu dizes mentiras; o SENHOR nosso Deus não te enviou a dizer: Não entreis no Egito, para ali habitar;

verses.original: כִּ֗י בָּרוּךְ֙ בֶּן־ נֵ֣רִיָּ֔ה מַסִּ֥ית אֹתְךָ֖ בָּ֑נוּ לְמַעַן֩ תֵּ֨ת אֹתָ֤נוּ בְיַֽד־ הַכַּשְׂדִּים֙ לְהָמִ֣ית אֹתָ֔נוּ וּלְהַגְל֥וֹת אֹתָ֖נוּ בָּבֶֽל׃
verses.transliteration: kî bā·rūḵ ben- nê·rî·yāh mas·sîṯ ’ō·ṯə·ḵā bā·nū lə·ma·‘an têṯ ’ō·ṯā·nū ḇə·yaḏ- hak·kaś·dîm lə·hā·mîṯ ’ō·ṯā·nū ū·lə·haḡ·lō·wṯ ’ō·ṯā·nū bā·ḇel
verses.literal: Rather Baruch son of Neriah is inciting you against us to deliver us into the hands of the Chaldeans so that they may put us to death or exile us to Babylon
verses.literalPt: Mas Baruque, filho de Nerias, te incita contra nós, para entregar-nos na mão dos caldeus, para nos matarem, ou para nos levarem cativos para Babilônia.

verses.original: וְלֹֽא־ שָׁמַע֩ יוֹחָנָ֨ן בֶּן־ קָרֵ֜חַ וְכָל־ שָׂרֵ֧י הַחֲיָלִ֛ים וְכָל־ הָעָ֖ם בְּק֣וֹל יְהוָ֑ה לָשֶׁ֖בֶת בְּאֶ֥רֶץ יְהוּדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lō- šā·ma‘ yō·w·ḥā·nān ben- qā·rê·aḥ wə·ḵāl śā·rê ha·ḥă·yā·lîm wə·ḵāl hā·‘ām bə·qō·wl Yah·weh lā·še·ḇeṯ bə·’e·reṣ yə·hū·ḏāh
verses.literal: So Johanan son of Kareah and all the commanders of the forces . . . . . . disobeyed the command of the LORD to stay in the land of Judah
verses.literalPt: Não obedeceu, pois, Joanã, filho de Careá, nem nenhum de todos os capitães dos exércitos, nem o povo todo, à voz do SENHOR, para ficarem na terra de Judá.

verses.original: וַיִּקַּ֞ח יוֹחָנָ֤ן בֶּן־ קָרֵ֙חַ֙ וְכָל־ שָׂרֵ֣י הַחֲיָלִ֔ים אֵ֖ת כָּל־ שְׁאֵרִ֣ית יְהוּדָ֑ה אֲשֶׁר־ שָׁ֗בוּ מִכָּל־ הַגּוֹיִם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִדְּחוּ־ שָׁ֔ם לָג֖וּר בְּאֶ֥רֶץ יְהוּדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·qaḥ yō·w·ḥā·nān ben- qā·rê·aḥ wə·ḵāl śā·rê ha·ḥă·yā·lîm ’êṯ kāl- šə·’ê·rîṯ yə·hū·ḏāh ’ă·šer- šā·ḇū mik·kāl hag·gō·w·yim ’ă·šer nid·də·ḥū- šām lā·ḡūr bə·’e·reṣ yə·hū·ḏāh
verses.literal: Instead, Johanan son of Kareah and all the commanders of the forces took the whole remnant of Judah those who had returned to the land of Judah from all the nations to which they had been scattered . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Antes tomou Joanã, filho de Careá, e todos os capitães dos exércitos a todo o restante de Judá, que havia voltado dentre todas as nações, para onde haviam sido lançados, para morarem na terra de Judá;

verses.original: אֶֽת־ הַ֠גְּבָרִים וְאֶת־ הַנָּשִׁ֣ים וְאֶת־ הַטַּף֮ וְאֶת־ בְּנ֣וֹת הַמֶּלֶךְ֒ וְאֵ֣ת כָּל־ הַנֶּ֗פֶשׁ אֲשֶׁ֤ר הִנִּ֙יחַ֙ נְבוּזַרְאֲדָ֣ן רַב־ טַבָּחִ֔ים אֶת־ גְּדַלְיָ֖הוּ בֶּן־ אֲחִיקָ֣ם בֶּן־ שָׁפָ֑ן וְאֵת֙ יִרְמְיָ֣הוּ הַנָּבִ֔יא וְאֶת־ בָּר֖וּךְ בֶּן־ נֵרִיָּֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’eṯ- hag·gə·ḇā·rîm wə·’eṯ- han·nā·šîm wə·’eṯ- haṭ·ṭap̄ wə·’eṯ- bə·nō·wṯ ham·me·leḵ wə·’êṯ kāl- han·ne·p̄eš ’ă·šer hin·nî·aḥ nə·ḇū·zar·’ă·ḏān raḇ- ṭab·bā·ḥîm ’eṯ- gə·ḏal·yā·hū ben- ’ă·ḥî·qām ben- šā·p̄ān wə·’êṯ yir·mə·yā·hū han·nā·ḇî wə·’eṯ- bā·rūḵ ben- nê·rî·yā·hū
verses.literal: the men the women the children the king’s daughters and everyone . . . whom Nebuzaradan captain of the guard had allowed to remain with Gedaliah son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan as well as Jeremiah the prophet and Baruch son of Neriah
verses.literalPt: Aos homens, e às mulheres, e aos meninos, e às filhas do rei, e a toda a alma que Nebuzaradã, capitão da guarda, deixara com Gedalias, filho de Aicão, filho de Safã; como também a Jeremias, o profeta, e a Baruque, filho de Nerias;

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֙אוּ֙ אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם כִּ֛י לֹ֥א שָׁמְע֖וּ בְּק֣וֹל יְהוָ֑ה וַיָּבֹ֖אוּ עַד־ תַּחְפַּנְחֵֽס׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō·’ū ’e·reṣ miṣ·ra·yim kî lō šā·mə·‘ū bə·qō·wl Yah·weh way·yā·ḇō·’ū ‘aḏ- taḥ·pan·ḥês
verses.literal: So they entered the land of Egypt because they did not obey the voice of the LORD and they went as far as Tahpanhes
verses.literalPt: E entraram na terra do Egito, porque não obedeceram à voz do SENHOR; e vieram até Tafnes.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֤י דְבַר־ יְהוָה֙ אֶֽל־ יִרְמְיָ֔הוּ בְּתַחְפַּנְחֵ֖ס לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh ’el- yir·mə·yā·hū bə·ṯaḥ·pan·ḥês lê·mōr
verses.literal: Then the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah at Tahpanhes . . .
verses.literalPt: Então veio a palavra do SENHOR a Jeremias, em Tafnes, dizendo:

verses.original: קַ֣ח בְּיָדְךָ֞ אֲבָנִ֣ים גְּדֹל֗וֹת וּטְמַנְתָּ֤ם בַּמֶּ֙לֶט֙ בַּמַּלְבֵּ֔ן אֲשֶׁ֛ר בְּפֶ֥תַח בֵּית־ פַּרְעֹ֖ה בְּתַחְפַּנְחֵ֑ס לְעֵינֵ֖י אֲנָשִׁ֥ים יְהוּדִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: qaḥ bə·yā·ḏə·ḵā ’ă·ḇā·nîm gə·ḏō·lō·wṯ ū·ṭə·man·tām bam·me·leṭ bam·mal·bên ’ă·šer bə·p̄e·ṯaḥ bêṯ- par·‘ōh bə·ṯaḥ·pan·ḥês lə·‘ê·nê ’ă·nā·šîm yə·hū·ḏîm
verses.literal: In the sight of the Jews pick up . . . some large stones and bury them in the clay of the brick pavement at the entrance to Pharaoh’s palace at Tahpanhes
verses.literalPt: Toma na tua mão pedras grandes, e esconde-as no barro, no forno que está à entrada da casa de Faraó, em Tafnes, perante os olhos dos homens de Judá,

verses.original: וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵיהֶ֡ם כֹּֽה־ אָמַר֩ יְהוָ֨ה צְבָא֜וֹת אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל הִנְנִ֤י שֹׁלֵ֙חַ֙ וְ֠לָקַחְתִּי אֶת־ נְבוּכַדְרֶאצַּ֤ר מֶֽלֶךְ־ בָּבֶל֙ עַבְדִּ֔י וְשַׂמְתִּ֣י כִסְא֔וֹ מִמַּ֛עַל לָאֲבָנִ֥ים הָאֵ֖לֶּה אֲשֶׁ֣ר טָמָ֑נְתִּי וְנָטָ֥ה אֶת־ שַׁפְרוּרוֹ עֲלֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·mar·tā ’ă·lê·hem kōh- ’ā·mar Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl hin·nî šō·lê·aḥ wə·lā·qaḥ·tî ’eṯ- nə·ḇū·ḵaḏ·reṣ·ṣar me·leḵ- bā·ḇel ‘aḇ·dî wə·śam·tî ḵis·’ōw mim·ma·‘al lā·’ă·ḇā·nîm hā·’êl·leh ’ă·šer ṭā·mā·nə·tî wə·nā·ṭāh ’eṯ- šap̄·rū·rō ‘ă·lê·hem
verses.literal: Then tell them that this is what the LORD of Hosts the God of Israel . . . says I will send for . . . My servant Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon and I will set his throne over these stones that I have embedded and he will spread his royal pavilion over them
verses.literalPt: E dize-lhes: Assim diz o SENHOR dos Exércitos, Deus de Israel: Eis que eu enviarei, e tomarei a Nabucodonosor, rei de Babilônia, meu servo, e porei o seu trono sobre estas pedras que escondi; e ele estenderá a sua tenda real sobre elas.

verses.original: וּבָאָה וְהִכָּ֖ה אֶת־ אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם אֲשֶׁ֧ר לַמָּ֣וֶת לַמָּ֗וֶת וַאֲשֶׁ֤ר לַשְּׁבִי֙ לַשֶּׁ֔בִי וַאֲשֶׁ֥ר לַחֶ֖רֶב לֶחָֽרֶב׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇå̄·ʾå̄h wə·hik·kāh ’eṯ- ’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim ’ă·šer lam·mā·weṯ lam·mā·weṯ wa·’ă·šer laš·šə·ḇî laš·še·ḇî wa·’ă·šer la·ḥe·reḇ le·ḥā·reḇ
verses.literal: He will come and strike down the land of Egypt bringing death to those destined for death captivity to those destined for captivity and the sword to those destined for the sword
verses.literalPt: E virá, e ferirá a terra do Egito; entregando para a morte, quem é para a morte; e quem é para o cativeiro, para o cativeiro; e quem é para a espada, para a espada.

verses.original: וְהִצַּ֣תִּי אֵ֗שׁ בְּבָתֵּי֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י מִצְרַ֔יִם וּשְׂרָפָ֖ם וְשָׁבָ֑ם וְעָטָה֩ אֶת־ אֶ֨רֶץ מִצְרַ֜יִם כַּאֲשֶׁר־ יַעְטֶ֤ה הָֽרֹעֶה֙ אֶת־ בִּגְד֔וֹ וְיָצָ֥א מִשָּׁ֖ם בְּשָׁלֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hiṣ·ṣat·tî ’êš bə·ḇāt·tê ’ĕ·lō·hê miṣ·ra·yim ū·śə·rā·p̄ām wə·šā·ḇām wə·‘ā·ṭāh ’eṯ- ’e·reṣ miṣ·ra·yim ka·’ă·šer- ya‘·ṭeh hā·rō·‘eh ’eṯ- biḡ·ḏōw wə·yā·ṣā miš·šām bə·šā·lō·wm
verses.literal: I will kindle a fire in the temples of the gods of Egypt and Nebuchadnezzar will burn those temples and take their gods as captives So he will wrap himself with the land of Egypt as a shepherd wraps himself in his garment and he will depart from there unscathed
verses.literalPt: E lançarei fogo às casas dos deuses do Egito, e queimá-los-á, e levá-los-á cativos; e vestir-se-á da terra do Egito, como veste o pastor a sua roupa, e sairá dali em paz.

verses.original: וְשִׁבַּ֗ר אֶֽת־ מַצְּבוֹת֙ בֵּ֣ית שֶׁ֔מֶשׁ אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם וְאֶת־ בָּתֵּ֥י אֱלֹהֵֽי־ מִצְרַ֖יִם יִשְׂרֹ֥ף בָּאֵֽשׁ׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·šib·bar ’eṯ- maṣ·ṣə·ḇō·wṯ bêṯ še·meš ’ă·šer bə·’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim wə·’eṯ- bāt·tê ’ĕ·lō·hê- miṣ·ra·yim yiś·rōp̄ bā·’êš
verses.literal: He will demolish the sacred pillars of the temple of the sun in the land of Egypt and he will burn down . . . the temples of the gods of Egypt
verses.literalPt: E quebrará as estátuas de Bete-Semes, que está na terra do Egito; e as casas dos deuses do Egito queimará a fogo.
